title: [ingest] :noindex:, :nowrap:, :nosignatures: are deprecated aliases; removal in Sphinx 9
summary: The old option names `:noindex:`, `:nowrap:`, and `:nosignatures:` are still accepted but silently aliased to `:no-index:`, `:no-wrap:`, and `:no-signatures:`. Comments in the source mark them for removal in Sphinx 9. Third-party extensions using the old names will silently work now but will break in Sphinx 9 without a deprecation warning.
